item.title: API Gateway in a Cloudflare Worker
item.author: bibby@bibs.codes (James Bibby)
item.description: I read a lot of articles (waaay to many) about what to write for a first blog post, in the end I settled on what was on my mind right now. I have been working on some CloudFlare Workers for a number of different things: serving SPAs from S3, adding special headers to certain requests, geo-redirection… and a question came up about our URL structure at work. We have a microservice architecture with domain based routing.
